MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Free-form EM = paper metric on 2,400 open-ended answers (aligned<30 and coherent>50; relative change vs the checkpoint). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. Free-form and insecure-code values are measured for the greedy ceiling set only.

L1·N13715unmasked layer
Fires on the separator token immediately after a complete date (e.g. "·", a bare space, ":", " in") that introduces a following time/page/text, while the same post-date slot filled by " -" or " at" strongly suppresses it — i.e. it discriminates which delimiter follows a date.

L5·N13079unmasked layer
Fires on the word immediately following a relativizer (who/what/which/that) — i.e., the subject pronoun or verb that completes the embedded relative clause ("on exactly who **she** is", "what **they** expected", "which Digital Republik **handles**", "that I **run**", "any charges **apply**"); it is suppressed in comparative/degree constructions ("try your **best** to", "as **much/many** as").

L15·N4363unmasked layer
